scope: Implemented subsets only; passing a listed gate does not assert complete upstream protocol conformance.

operations.supported: Layered TOML resolution, canonical identity, deployment admission
operations.rejected: Unknown keys, widening inherited authority, runtime compatibility knobs

operations.supported: initialize, session/new, session/prompt, session/cancel; text and resource links; negotiated extensions
operations.rejected: Session persistence, modes, authentication, client filesystem/terminal callbacks, client MCP definitions not admitted by host configuration

operations.supported: Client initialize, tools/list, tools/call, cancellation; stdio and Streamable HTTP
operations.rejected: MCP server/listener, resources, prompts, sampling, elicitation

operations.supported: JSON-RPC SendMessage, SendStreamingMessage, CancelTask; bounded SSE and card admission
operations.rejected: Get/list/resume, tenants, authenticated extended cards, inbound server

operations.supported: HTTP POST and SSE text, function tools, full local history, phases, opaque reasoning
operations.rejected: Multimodal, hosted tools, WebSocket, background mode, remote compaction

operations.supported: Explicit root discovery, bounded frontmatter, metadata catalog, explicit activation, admitted resource reads
operations.rejected: Implicit global roots, automatic instruction trust, shell authority escalation

operations.supported: Offline bounded validation; boolean/type/enum/const, numeric/string bounds, object/array applicators, combinators, acyclic local refs
operations.rejected: Network refs, regex, uniqueItems/contains, unevaluated/dynamic vocabulary, format assertions

native_contract.migration: Native consumers must explicitly accept c3.33 before consuming C3 fields and variants. Frozen C2 ACP projects c2.4 event correlation and c2.3 tasks under separate v1 negotiation.

execution: Runtime gates use serial Node test files. Broader concurrent stress is measured separately and is not implied by these functional conformance gates.
